method.semantic_review: Read complete ChemMon Table 10 pp.113–143, PRE pp.4–21 and USE pp.4–28, including all field sections, tables, examples and rule continuations. Compared triggers, scope, severity, exceptions, field names, catalogues, required/optional status and numeric conventions with wiki references. Reconciled related summaries. This is an assistant comparison, not execution against an EFSA validator.
method.severity_extraction: Independently extracted Error/Warning preceding Active/Inactive in the original PDF line containing each source ID, using pdftotext -layout and source inventory page locators. Wrapped CHEMON _a/_b ID suffixes joined. Source table lines below preserve the extraction evidence; semantic review was a separate reading of complete rows.
method.field_inventory: Manually transcribed Table 1 names, required/optional conditions and catalogues; compared with full field sections. PRE has 18 fields in 16 sections, USE has 31 in 29.

limitations: Independent human review unavailable. No human-approved labels, model-quality score or live-provider evaluation.
2013 SSD2 foundation and remaining ChemMon prose are not exhaustively reviewed.
No current-law, live-catalogue or executable collection-validator verification.
Open source ambiguities SRC-012 (Boolean grouping), SRC-013 (USE19), SRC-014 (CONCLUS hierarchy spelling) are documented rather than silently resolved.
